action_items: OPTIONAL (from iter 258 still open, not in this iteration's scope): partner_positions.py notification insert without notification_id → E11000 dup-key. Fix by adding str(uuid.uuid4()) on the notification insert.

Backend already confirmed these responses are correct via live API tests.
critical_code_review_comments: POSITION_STRUCTURE_REQUIREMENT thresholds (100/5/3/5) are hardcoded in partner_positions.py. Consider making these configurable via app_settings collection so ops can tune without a code deploy.

is_structure_valid() has module-level in-memory cache with 5min TTL — NOT shared across FastAPI workers. In a multi-worker deploy the cache hit-rate would drop; acceptable for now since traffic is low but flag for future.

get_structure_report() iterates all L1 downlines then recursively calls is_structure_valid for each — for a NATIONAL_PARTNER with a large tree this becomes N Mongo queries (5 STATE × 3 REGIONAL × 5 DISTRICT × 100 elite = up to 7500 lookups). The cache helps but a single aggregation pipeline would be dramatically faster.

structure_report response includes 'valid_downlines' list (line ~247) but the frontend only reads current_count/required_count; consider limiting the returned array size to avoid oversized payloads for real NATIONAL/STATE partners.

Frontend ReferralsEnhanced.js correctly guards: partnerPosition.structure_required && partnerPosition.structure_report before rendering the progress bar (line 683). Colour switches emerald/rose based on structure_met — good UX.
Live API test suite (test_structure_gate_live.py) added — 4 new tests. Uses idempotent assign/revoke so it can be re-run without teardown.
